text: Liscor's branch is a large taproom-like hall; the Guild lets people report dangerous monsters, post quests and bounties, and adventurers take assignments from a board
patrons include Drake warriors, Gnolls in chainmail and one in plate, Antinium, and Drake and Antinium mages in robes with staves or daggers
Liscor's branch has few members, since locals join the army or Watch
offers a copper piece for every four pairs of Goblin ears
guildmaster is an elderly Drake with dusky purple scales and Selys's grandmother
Drake adventurers refuse to enter the Ruins, saying the trapped should have saved themselves
pays four silver per Corusdeer antler
takes ten percent of spoils from a dungeon raid; the Horns paid it, plus healer and blacksmith costs, lavish inn stay
cities can demand adventurers' defense help; city and guild tax artifacts recovered; bounties on Shield Spider shells, Raskghar, Lurkersnatch Fish, slime cores, Dropbat teeth, Corusdeer horns
forbids using people or listed species for undead
a female Gnoll shopkeeper; she forgives Erin, smells the blood and oil of her fight, and calls her the human who slew the Goblin Chieftain
says Lism gave Erin a bag on purpose instead of delivery

has a [Spot Deception] skill
serves raw chopped meat, "scurry-food"

faints at the number eight billion

plans to give Erin "fangs to protect herself" rather than set guards

Gnoll shopkeeper in the Market Street meeting

has cast iron frying pans for sale and lends healing potions on credit

sells small sleds to citizens

replies the Gnolls will await the delivery

negotiates a higher cut than Octavia's proposed 50 percent to sell her potions, citing her high [Shopkeeper] level

orders the book guarded by [Warriors] and kept secret; says shopkeepers can tell magical writing from written language and sends Gnolls for translation lenses

says Erin Solstice and Ryoka Griffin are of the same tribe

reports Brunkr was torn apart by a monster; this is the cover story

back at a smaller stall at the market's edge; takes orders for suppliers, charges six gold for Erin's list

has hidden Gnoll guards watching her apartment
keeps a poison-trapped chest with two keys under her bed; inside is a spellbook the Silverfangs plan to give the Meeting of the Tribes
Gnolls on rooftops with bows defend the city centre
street vendor ten years; sister is the chieftain of the Silverfang Tribe; knows Lyonette is a [Princess]
Gnoll merchant who helps Bird buy a reflexed composite bow
asks when Gnolls will get a place on the stage

the Raskghar are an ancient offshoot of Gnolls that regain intelligence only under the moon
now a [Royal Shopkeeper]; Skills [Imperial Appraiser] (replaces [Quality Scent]) and [Silvertouched Wares] giving every purchase a silver coin's extra value
eats silkap, a traditional Gnoll pork paste; keeps Brunkr's bandages in her living room, her nephew deceased
persuades the council to stay and fight by recounting Gnoll history and the Waning World
former apprentice [Shaman]; leads a gathering of magic [Everdawn's Radiance], a Tier 1 spell of courage

highly placed in the Silverfang Tribe; Meeting of Tribes is every twenty years; she is preparing a gift
proposes a dungeon entry fee, a monster-parts inventory and request system, Liscor expansion, a rent cap, Antinium building aid, and ending the Goblin bounty
wants to be the first Gnoll on Liscor's Council and needs Liscor to hold a vote; the Council currently chooses its own members
pick Klbkch's Hive as the funding source; Zevara needs a day or two before approaching him
launch the election push with Selys

launches the movement for a Liscor Council election
allied to force a Council election with one Council member per district
lives in a district with nearly one Gnoll per three Drakes
faces Lism Swifttail, who lives in her district, as a rival candidate
campaigning with candidates Raekea (smith and [Armorer]), Elirr, and Senior Guardswoman Beilmark; four more candidates, one per district
agrees not to call for Calruz's death in her campaign
sells Palt ingredients at a market stall
drink at Elirr's pet shop to mark the end of the month of Rerrk; the meeting of tribes is about two months away, last held ten years ago

kiss, revealing they are a secret couple

runs beside the cart overnight and reeks of sweat

a "Levelist", the old-fashioned kind; about Level 20
about 6'7" plus horns, goat legs with cloven hooves
calls Runners non-warriors, women weaker; tells Garia to move

carries Ceria away and refuses to fight Ryoka
promises "upon my honor" not to attack guests
leads the Horns; objects to "Bull Guy", says Minotaurs are not bulls or cattle
eats beef; polite eater; dislikes many questions
planned a death duel with Ksmvr; found the city gates closed
asks Pawn why he did not resist; calls Pawn a slave
recognizes Gazi and gives her room
says women must be warriors, calls Toren worthless
sole skill [Hammer Blow]; it shatters a waist-high boulder
will train Erin starting tomorrow, two days before the ruins
thinks Ryoka is strong and Erin's music should be protected
the singer must not be silenced
about 300 pounds, closer to seven feet than six

says Erin unlocked a skill and is gifted at battle

plans to lure the dead with his voice; Lir casts [Loudness] and [Muffle]
kills a Crypt Lord with [Hammer Blow] and rips off another's head

lost under the swarm
Minotaur, never found among the crypt dead; missing arm, axe; Olesm suspects he fell into the trap
possibly alive, according to Olesm and Pisces's evidence
finds Ceria's cow drawing and a hair and says her name, then walks back into the dungeon
alive in the dungeon and on the trail of the Horns

the Raskghar are his team and tools, strengthened by the full moon and by the Gnolls
revealed as the Raskghar's Great Chieftain, and insane
former Captain of the Horns of Hammerad, now leads the Raskghar; right arm missing, rough dirty fur, stinks of blood, has fleas, cracked tooth
believes the Horns survive and that Skinner still lives until Ceria tells him they are dead and Erin killed Skinner with acid jars
his arm broke Ceria's dagger tip unharmed; he beat a Raskghar who hurt her, then tended her head wound gently

says the Raskghar are his tribe, he forged the isolated camps together, and he plans an offensive using Ceria's magic; Raskghar are beasts most of the month and regain intelligence only near full moon
moves the Raskghar camp nightly between set locations; carries a magic-edged axe
ordered a day attack on Liscor, disguising that Raskghar can act in daylight; a team with artifacts was spotted and returned with Ceria and a few Gnolls
limits the ritual to one Gnoll per day, hits the female who wants more, and gives her command of Dailre's Fist; she calls him Chieftain
threatens to sacrifice another Gnoll each time Ceria disobeys and offers to free a few if she obeys
says the Horns' mission is still on and the dungeon is half conquered
shown as insane, lacking his old self, with sporadic lucidity
moved most Raskghar out of the way, sending kill teams against the Halfseekers; says the dungeon hunts everyone but him and claims he alone has the Skill
says adventurers will take months to reach him and he will take the dungeon's heart
magic axe of false-gold metal with a green edge; with it he grows a transparent blade three times the head's size and uses [Hammer Blow] and [Gore Splash]
says he fell through a trapped floor into a Raskghar graveyard after losing his arm, was captured by Raskghar, killed two sleeping Raskghar including the Chieftain, and was made Chieftain
says his intellect does not wane with the moon and he forged the Raskghar camps into a disciplined force
asks three times if the other Horns are dead; Ceria says Gerial saved her, Skinner killed him, and Hunt, Corr and Sostrom died and she buried them
insists the Horns of Hammerad was his idea and name, and briefly seizes Ceria in a rage
asks if the fallen team members' families were paid; Ceria says Yvlon arranged it
points out the monsters become visible when dead or splashed with blood; Gnolls in the cages who drank dungeon water cannot see monsters, while others can

believes Ceria sees them because she is a half-Elf; Ceria denies half-Elves see through invisibility

describes Snatcher as causing paralysis, resisting enchanted arrows, and collecting heads on sticks
says the dungeon is comparable to the one Niers Astoragon conquered before founding the Forgotten Wing Company
chokes the female, who submits; backhands another Raskghar; says some Gnolls and the white one will be spared depending on Ceria

strikes Ceria with his axe handle and orders the Gnolls carried away
names the awakened his vanguard, to bear artifacts, with Nokha leading
beats Ceria for betrayal, carries her to his bed, and stops only when she says "Ryoka would be so proud"
says forty-four Gnolls remain and plans to lead the awakened into the city next
confesses he knows sacrificing Gnolls is wrong but says only glory and finding the dungeon's heart matter; says he has [Thick Skin] now
agrees to spare the Gnolls with no more sacrifices "for now" in exchange for Ceria's help against the awakened
cancels sacrifices that night and orders the awakened to prepare to enter the city, backing down at the sight of a head on a stick
argue over whether mute means unable to make sounds or unable to speak; Ceria says Pisces read it in a book
Chieftain of the Raskghar camp, a one-armed Minotaur with an enchanted axe; the awakened chafe at his rule

loses to the Horns and is taken prisoner
held shackled and burnt in prison; Ceria let him live

names his lost team Gerial, Hunt, Terr, Marian, Coblat, Grimsore, Sostrom, Barr; does not recall Olesm
lost an arm, went mad and killed people, is in jail and expected to die
imprisoned Minotaur; Zevara says Ceria visits him four times a week and she must still schedule his execution; he feels the pull of the dungeon's treasure

Silver-rank Minotaur, held in a cell with a magic barrier made to hold Gold-rank prisoners; one-armed

asks for a weapon and an honorable death fighting a friend; Ceria cannot

prisoner who says the Wistram scan found no spells on him; Zevara promises an Enchanter visit and a legal plan to help him
released to fight the Creler nest in the inn

new class [Honorbound Prisoner] and sentence of hard labour

asks Bezale to send a letter to someone with the right to judge; she agrees

spits on the cloak, turning it into a saliva cloak

effectively take over the Redfang tribe's leadership

bond as last survivors and Numbtongue helps him clear Shield Spiders

describes fighting thousands of Crelers at the inn
sees Garen, Reiss and the dead Goblins on the hill and learns Rabbiteater and Badarrow are absent
go mining for gems and opals ("Pyrite thinks") with picks, potions, guitar and sword
plays an acoustic guitar that sounds electric; covers Don't Stop Believin' by Journey and other songs from Erin's world; refuses to sing

reaches [Goblin Soulbard Level 32!] and obtains [Song - Harmony of Mana]
realises first the grass-charged mana and acts as a conduit for it
tripped Erin into the pond when Mrsha signalled
receives six potions from Octavia: Barkskin, Quickened Body, Vanish (14 seconds), Bat's Ear, Jumping, Blast Vial; Octavia is Saliss of Lights' apprentice and her new shop is in the inn

keeps weapons close, taught Mrsha to quick-release her wand
carries Pyrite's memories; Reiss's voice offers help; Numbtongue refuses Reiss for now

temporary Skills [Directional Sound] and [Soul's Armaments: Mundane]; summons a three-minute pickaxe and Pyrite's battleaxe
go fishing at a pond in the High Passes with Apista, calling themselves the Bee Rescue Team
reads the Liscorian Gazette and drinks Blue Tea, which turns the tongue blue for about a day
refuses to train Mrsha, Visma and Ekirra as [Warrior]s, hitting them until they gave up
